title: Repair and Emergency Service Calls — Premium Discount Points for Annual and Auto-Renewing Comfort Club Billing
content:
How a member's Comfort Club dues are billed earns points on the member premium percentage of an after-hours call under Repair and Emergency Service Calls. The record read is the billing frequency and the automatic renewal setting on the member's agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements.

**Rule.** A member whose agreement is billed annually and set to renew automatically adds 5 points to the member premium percentage. A member billed annually without automatic renewal adds 3 points. A member billed monthly adds nothing. The points are added to the member premium percentage before the 100 percent ceiling is applied.

| Billing frequency | Automatic renewal | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | On | 5 |
| Annual | Off | 3 |
| Monthly | On or off | None |

## Example (hypothetical)

Two members on the same tier differ only in billing. The member billed annually with automatic renewal adds 5 points. The member billed monthly adds none. If the annual member switches automatic renewal off, that member adds 3 points.
